Annotated Heatmap

Source: R/figure-plots-matrices.R
PlotAnnotatedHeatmap.Rd

Draws a matrix of coloured cells, optionally with the values printed in the cells, coloured annotation boxes left of the rows, coloured or boxed column labels and a colour bar. Colours follow a 256-step ramp between the anchors of a named scale ("blues", "rdbu_r", "rdbu", "greys") or of given colours, as image heatmaps of common figure code; values can be coloured on a log10(x + 1) scale while the printed numbers stay raw.

Usage

PlotAnnotatedHeatmap(
  data,
  row = "row",
  column = "column",
  value = "value",
  rows = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  row_order_by = NULL,
  column_order_by = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  column_labels = NULL,
  scale = "blues",
  limits = NULL,
  transform = c("identity", "log10p1"),
  fill_column = NULL,
  missing_colour = "#EEEEEE",
  drop_columns_below = NULL,
  cell_text = NULL,
  row_colours = NULL,
  row_box = c(-1.05, 0.4, 0.7),
  column_colours = NULL,
  column_fills = NULL,
  column_fill_alpha = 0.55,
  column_angle = 0,
  column_size = 5.1,
  column_pad = 3.5,
  row_size = 5.3,
  row_pad = 3.5,
  row_italic = FALSE,
  show_rows = TRUE,
  show_columns = TRUE,
  x_label = NULL,
  x_label_size = 5,
  x_label_pad = 2,
  colourbar = NULL,
  texts = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Long data: one row per matrix cell.

row, column, value

Column names.

rows, columns

Row order (top to bottom) and column order (left to right): character vectors or data frames (ordered by a rank column if present); default first appearance.

row_order_by, column_order_by

Optional numeric columns of data giving the row or column order.

row_labels, column_labels

Display labels: named mapping or vector.

scale

Colour scale name or vector of anchor colours.

limits

Colour limits (on the transformed scale); default the range.

transform

"identity" or "log10p1" (colour by log10(x + 1)).

fill_column

Optional column with explicit cell colours (overrides scale).

missing_colour

Colour of missing cells.

drop_columns_below

Drop columns whose largest value is below this.

cell_text

Optional list printing values in cells: min (smallest value printed), format ("fixed" with digits, or "count": thousands separator and "12k" from abbreviate upwards), white_above (raw values above it are printed in light_colour), size (points).

row_colours

Named colours of row annotation boxes.

row_box

Box geometry c(left, width, height) in column units, left measured from the centre of the first column.

column_colours

Named text colours of column labels.

column_fills

Named colours of rounded boxes behind column labels.

column_fill_alpha

Opacity of these boxes.

column_angle, column_size, column_pad

Column label rotation (degrees), size and distance from the matrix (points).

row_size, row_pad, row_italic

Row label size, distance and italics.

show_rows, show_columns

Draw row or column labels.

x_label, x_label_size, x_label_pad

Title below the column labels.

colourbar

Optional list: box (c(left, bottom, width, height) in panel fractions), title, breaks, labels, tick_size, title_size.

texts

Optional texts at panel fractions (list of label, xy, size, colour, bold, hjust, vjust, angle); labels may use FormatTemplate() placeholders filled from values.

values

Optional data frame for text templates.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- expand.grid(row = c("a", "b"), column = c("x", "y", "z"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d$value <- c(85, 3, 9, 15, 2, 67)
PlotAnnotatedHeatmap(d, limits = c(0, 80), cell_text = list(min = 1, white_above = 45),
                     row_colours = c(a = "#e34948", b = "#eda100"))
